note: A passkey that gives no secret, as when a password manager saves it instead of the device. Simulated in Chrome without a screen with a reader that lacks the prf extension. Demo, encrypted.

afterPasskeyWithoutSecret.text: The passkey that was made cannot protect a passphrase. That happens when a password manager such as LastPass saves the passkey instead of the device. Nothing was remembered; delete the passkey in the password manager.

afterFallback.text: This device now remembers your passphrase and opens without asking.
